description: This file defines a report parser class for generating special message invoices in Odoo, including methods for retrieving messages and invoice line details.

classes.name: account_invoice_with_message
classes.description: A report parser class for handling invoice messages and invoice line details in Odoo.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser, setting up local context with time, spcl_msg, and invoice_lines methods.

methods.name: spcl_msg
methods.description: Retrieves a special message associated with a given form message ID.

methods.name: invoice_lines
methods.description: Generates detailed invoice line data, including tax info, quantities, prices, and formatting for report rendering.
